scope: Disposable Cloudflare CDP probes and local private-fetch hardening; no production integration or finding closure
authentication: Existing Wrangler OAuth, never printed or persisted by these probes

directBrowserPolicy.websocketFrameError: Error during WebSocket handshake: Unexpected response code: 403
directBrowserPolicy.limitation: The WebSocket error alone does not attribute denial to guardrails or prove general WSS/private-address containment.

failedFixtureNavigation.limitation: No provider-local private services or metadata were intentionally probed, and policy was not disabled. This failure does not prove unpublished asset compatibility.

scopedRoutingFixture.transportSeam: Only private fixture fetches were mapped to an owned local listener. Existing inspection routing and token verification were otherwise unchanged at the source baseline.

callerSideApiRequestProbe.meaning: CDP API request IO runs on the trusted caller and is not constrained by the remote browser guardrails. This is a transport prerequisite, not an exploit demonstrated against production.

scopedRoutingFixture.limitation: Synthetic private fixture, not a real game, R2 generation, public realtime session, or proof of the hardened fetch implementation added afterward.

localImplementation.status: Uncommitted hardening, no provider transport switch
localImplementation.policy: Existing canonical public-address classifier; validate all A/AAAA answers and dial a validated numeric address. TLS checks the original hostname. GET/HEAD only, no redirects/retries or inherited browser authorization/cookies.
localImplementation.limits: 25 MiB per file, 500 MiB and 10000 requests per capture derived from existing release upload limits; eight concurrent fetches. Context close cancels queued requests, DNS and sockets.
localImplementation.testHarnessCorrection: An initial parameterized mixed-DNS test incorrectly spread an array and made one credential-free HTTP request to public 1.1.1.1 (HTTP 409). Corrected object cases and deny-by-default HTTP/HTTPS mocks prevent unintended non-fixture IO.
localImplementation.sourceTypecheckAndLint: Passed scoped changed gate; cold affected-project check took 9408 ms, above the 5000 ms warm target
localImplementation.fullBatchAndIndependentReview: Not run for this unpushed slice; still required before substantial delivery

remaining: Provider-level public-only network guarantees and compatible public HTTP(S)/WS(S), including private/mixed/rebound DNS and direct bypass
